initial_draft_reproduction.correction: Freeze explicit/caller lineage at admission; guard before and after the native callback; clear raw arguments even if scope admission fails.

native_raise_attempt.description: Raising a fresh fixed exception outside the native handler still transported executor frames containing the raw callback arguments. The revoked callback no longer entered, but held exception tracebacks still retained both raw inputs.
native_raise_attempt.correction: Return a typed result/fixed error enum from the native wrapper. Raise the public error on-loop after disposing transport results and raw arguments; do not transport the callback exception.
